issues: Uses `re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', ...)`, which does not handle bracketed text spanning multiple lines.
The regex approach also mishandles nested square brackets, potentially leaving bracket contents or stray brackets in the extracted text.
The default `TfidfVectorizer` token pattern ignores single-character words, even though the task says words should be keys.
